name: @story/visualizer-landing-page
comment:dependencies: The story list in front of the Visualizer and SingleEngine (multiple stories, phase 6). It talks to `Visualizer/server` only through `@story/visualizer-protocol` (the global routes plus a story's `/info`), and imports no story at all: no `@story/data`, `@story/core` or `@story/types`. `@emotion/react` is the required peer of `@emotion/styled` and `@mui/material`, declared here as in the client.
